fact.en: Assuming Ashoka's Dhamma policy caused the collapse due to 'pacifism'—modern historians like H.C. Raychaudhuri reject this, noting Ashoka never disbanded the army.

fact.en: Thinking the empire collapsed overnight; it was a process of regional fragmentation over 50 years.

fact.en: Believing the Mauryas were overthrown by foreign invaders; it was an internal military coup by Pushyamitra Shunga.
